subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining work be narrowed to an Android Voice/Talk agent/session selector, or kept as a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The Android source gap is clear, but current main already covers per-agent TTS and has selected or active session routing on iOS/macOS, so automation should not choose the platform scope or permanent UX model.

options.title: Android-first Voice selector
options.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk target selection first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before broadening scope.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one Talk/Voice selector model across Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Wait for Chat selector outcome
options.body: Let the Android Chat selector PR settle first, then reuse any accepted selected-agent state model for Voice/Talk.

recommendation.title: Android-first Voice selector
recommendation.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk target selection first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before broadening scope.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the completed TTS half versus remaining Talk/Voice selection and has recent history in both TTS config and Android Talk runtime paths.
